rules.explain: A median regression above explainAbovePercent needs a stated reason in the pull request; a stable regression above blockAbovePercent blocks the change unless the pull request justifies it explicitly.

store.note: Budgets for the shared file store, checked on one report of scripts/benchmark-store.mjs. They apply to the placement mode in force (defaultStoreMode of the platform that ran the report, or the one named with --mode). Where the default is off they bound the mode under evaluation, and a run that exceeds them is the evidence that the default stays off; where it is a mode (hardlink on Windows), a run that exceeds them is the evidence to turn it off.

budgets.why: The first install fills the store and places from it: it may not cost more than 10% over writing the files.
A repeat install from a full store must not be slower than writing the files, or the store has no purpose.
An update that changes a tenth of the files must not be slower than writing all of them.
Removing an installed tree (links, read-only files) may not cost more than 10% over removing a tree that extraction wrote.

installMetrics.note: Compared between two reports of scripts/benchmark-install.mjs for the same distribution, workload and machine: the candidate and the baseline (a revision before the change). Counts and bytes must not grow past the block threshold; times follow the same rule on the median of the run. Personal must not regress because developer improved: run each of personal, managed, and developer.

launch.note: Structural, enforced by packages/core/src/store-boundary.test.ts: a launch performs no store access, no authoring, no deep verification, and no collection.
